title: quantale-enriched-sheaf
description: A Q-enriched sheaf on a Grothendieck site: a contravariant functor from the site's indexing category into complete weighted lattices that satisfies the sheaf gluing condition. It generalizes graph-indexed quantale-enriched cellular sheaves so the framework applies to the bitopological settling site.

quantale.description: a commutative unital quantale Q = (Q, *, 1, <=): a complete lattice with an associative-commutative-unital product * distributing over arbitrary suprema

distributesOverSuprema.description: p * (\/_i q_i) = \/_i (p * q_i) for arbitrary suprema

site.description: the Grothendieck site (T, J) over which the sheaf is indexed; here the bitopological settling site

presheaf.description: a Q-enriched presheaf F : T^op -> Q-Cat_cwl assigning each object a stalk and each morphism a contravariant Q-functor

stalk.description: F(sigma): a Q-category admitting all weighted meets and joins

restriction.description: F(f) : F(tau) -> F(sigma) for each f : sigma -> tau, contravariant

sheafCondition.description: for every covering family {f_i : U_i -> U} in J, F(U) -> Eq(prod_i F(U_i) => prod_{i,j} F(U_i x_U U_j)) is an equivalence of complete weighted lattices
